gui.overpowered_technology.black_hole.no: Black Holes are not allowed in this Dimension.
gui.overpowered_technology.jei_descripti: A unique gem made from 8 different types of gems. It is very strong, and may even contain hidden mysterious power.
A dense crystal that contains concentrated energy. Understanding how to use this unique energy is the key to unlocking new technologies.
An Energy Crystal shattered into pieces. Although not as powerful as a whole Energy Crystal, they may still be useful.
A block made out of Celestial Gems. It is just as strong, and also produces light.

This crystal has similar properties to the Energy Crystal, however the energy within the crystal cannot be properly identified, and seems to defy all laws of physics. The discovery of the Void crystal will lead to all new reality-bending technologies.
The Null Block, once placed down, can never be interacted with again. You can only replace it with another block.
Celestial Tools have 3x the durability of Diamond tools, and are generally faster and stronger. Overpowered tools cannot be enchanted.
Void Tools are still being worked on. Although they currently have 5x the durability of Diamond tools, they are not faster or stronger. Void tools cannot be enchanted.
This is a crafting item. Mainly used in machines that need to scan an object.
This is a crafting item. Used whenever you need a high-energy laser to burn or destroy something.
A Power Regulator combined with a Scanning Laser. Uses a beam of energy fluctuations to affect an object externally.
Emits a special light that is so fast and thick with energy, that you can actually feel it hitting you as you touch it. With enough pressure, this light won't let anything pass through it.
A Scanning Laser combined with a Matter/Energy Converter. This can scan objects and transform its atoms into energy or manipulate them in some other way.
A concentrated form of energy in plasma state, kept together in a magnetic field.
By experimenting with the unique energy emitted from the Energy Crystal, you are able to create this, the special device that allows matter/energy manipulation.
A sealed container that keeps objects inside a vacuum.
A sealed vacuum container, reinforced with Titanium. Used when experimenting with objects that involve extreme pressures or stress.
Mysterious dimensional energy that is often encountered when traversing different dimensions. Prolonged exposure could disrupt your physical being.
A unique form of matter that is so dense, it is virtually indescructable.
The Dimensional Anchor, when kept in your inventory, will prevent you from traveling to other dimensions, and also protects you from a Black Hole.

The Energy Extractor can extract energy from Energy Crystals. Doing so will consume the Energy Crystal. You can insert either an Energy Crystal, Energy Crystal Shards, or a Light Block. Each generate Energy at different rates.
Data Cable is used in the construction of the Portal and the construction of the Fusion Energy structure, as well as some crafting recipes.
The Gem Converter, as the name implies, allows you to convert one gem type to another. This machine works with Ruby, Topaz, Citrine, Emerald, Diamond, Sapphire, Amethyst, and Quartz.
This machine will transform Energy Crystals into Void Crystals, and transforms Void Crystals into Energy Crystals.
Insert a Book and a type of gem, and this machine will enchant the Book. The enchantment you get depends on the gem type.
Monsters will occasionally drop an unidentified item. Insert those items into this machine and it will identify them for you.
The Portal Control Panel is the machine that generates the Portal to the Unknown Dimension. It must be connected to the main Portal Frame using Data Cable.

The main portal frame consists of a ring of blocks arranged in a 5x5 area. 8 Portal Frames must be placed in the corners and sides while the other spaces can be filled with either Data Cable or the Iron Frame Block. Finally, a different gem Block must be inserted into each Portal Frame before you can generate the portal.

This is the machine that controls how Lasers operate. Attach Lasers pointing in the direction you want to fire. Access the machine and set how far you want the laser to shoot. Then, once the laser has built up enough energy, a redstone signal will fire the laser. If multiple Laser machines are adjacent to each other, they will all fire at once.

These are the Laser Cannons that you attach to Laser Machines. Access the Laser machine to configure how the Laser operates. Lasers will mine blocks as though you mined them with the correct tool. Entities caught in the Laser Beams will also get set on fire.

The Energy Suspension Bridge, when supplied with power and activated with a redstone signal, will spawn an energy bridge across to another Energy Suspension Bridge. You must insert a Lens of the color you want. And the space between the two Energy Suspension Blocks must be clear.
Insert Ores into this machine and it will produce double the output. Automatically works with Ores from other mods if they've registered their Ore with an Ore tag.
This machine requires a lot of power, and must be running at all times. After a while, it will generate a random gem shard. You can combine 9 gem shards of the same type to make a full gem.
This machine generates plasma using High-Intensity Lasers and Energy Stabilizers. It's no surprise that this machine uses a lot of energy.

By carefully keeping a singularity inside a reinforced sealed container, and controlled by extreme magnetic fields, this machine allows you to compress objects to their absolute limits, as all matter is drawn towards the singularity.
Whoa. Be careful with this! If you place this down, it will erase your world! I don't know how you got this, but you should destroy it immediately!
Part of the Fusion Energy structure, this is the block that is in the center. It must contain a Fusion Core in order to be considered valid.

Part of the Fusion Energy structure. You need 6 of these to be placed on each side of the Fusion Chamber, 5 blocks away. Each one must be connected to each other and the Fusion Energy Converter with Data Cable.
Part of the Fusion Energy structure. You must craft 6 of these and place them on each Fusion Control Unit, pointing towards the Fusion Chamber.

Part of the Fusion Energy structure. You must first set up the other blocks in their correct positions, then connect the Fusion Energy Converter with the Fusion Control Units using Data Cable. The Fusion Chamber must also contain a Fusion Core. Once everything is set up correctly, activate the Fusion Energy Converter with a redstone signal to turn it on and start generating Energy.
gui.overpowered_technology.portal_warnin: §cBeware§r: Traveling to the Unknown Dimension is still buggy. There's a chance you may spawn in the air and fall to your death! (I believe this occurs when you enter for the first time because the dimension hasn't loaded yet.) We recommend entering the portal in Creative Mode, or disabling the Portal in the config. (Boots with Feather Falling IV won't work. I've tried.) If you're quick to enter the portal a second time before the portal goes away you might spawn on the ground. Enter at your own risk! This will get fixed in a later update.
advancements.overpowered_technology.all_: Collect all 8 types of gems needed to craft the Celestial Gem
advancements.overpowered_technology.fire: Fire a laser the maximum distance you can set
advancements.overpowered_technology.maxi: Activate an Energy Suspension Bridge with the longest distance possible.
advancements.overpowered_technology.iden: Use the Identifier to identify something
advancements.overpowered_technology.dime: Find Dimensional Flux after entering the portal.
advancements.overpowered_technology.fusi: Craft all the components needed to construct the Fusion Energy structure
advancements.overpowered_technology.worl: Use a Black Hole to destroy part of the world
advancements.overpowered_technology.surv: Use a Dimensional Anchor to survive a Black Hole
advancements.overpowered_technology.unim: Use the Matter Compressor to obtain Unimatter.
